overview_description.description: WhizzTips is the platform that connects skills to needs locally...Worldwide! Most of us have gained special skills during our studies and working lives but we mostly use them to help a grumpy boss or the guy next door. Let’s share our gifts with more people. Join a community where we all help each other and find the fixes we need. WhizzTips makes this happen. Experts - “Whizzes” and people looking for “Tips” connect to get it done – Affordably & Without Boundaries.
